did: Built and tested this round. The owner opened Connections and found two new cards under Visitor statistics and ads: Facebook (Meta) Pixel and Google Analytics. A Pixel ID and a Measurement ID were typed, the cards were switched on and set to Live, and the public site was then loaded.

checks.text: Both cards ask for one number only and say where to find it; a Pixel ID must be 10 to 20 digits and a Measurement ID must look like G-ABC123XYZ4, anything else is refused with a plain reason (so nothing odd can be placed in the page)
Nothing is sent until the card is on and set to Live; in Test mode, or switched off, the public page carries no tracking code at all
Once Live, every public page loads the tags, and the site reports page views, product views, adds to cart, searches and orders; staff, the owner and the admin screens are never counted
Google Analytics is told not to count its own page view because the app sends them as the page changes, so one visit is not counted twice
The Test button answers without sending anything (12 automatic tests)

notes: Built this round. NOT verified live: whether Meta or Google actually receive and show the events, because that needs the owner's real ids and their dashboards; the page code and the events were checked in the app and in 12 automatic tests. While fixing it a bug was found where a key containing a digit (analytics:ga4) could not be saved from the screen; fixed and covered by a test.
